description: Ω8 discovery engine — verification: THE PROMOTION GATE. Consumes a mapping report (discovery.map@1 output) plus caller-supplied postcondition probes (fixture replay harness: each probe {candidateId, preState, postState, passed, evidence}) and decides promotion by PROOF, never confidence: score = passedProbes/total with every probe citing resolvable vault evidence; score ≥ policy.threshold AND evidence complete → PROMOTED (candidate status rewritten in the returned report + the promotion event appended to the vault with full evidence); otherwise the candidate stays DRAFT with a gap report. The thresholds are POLICY DATA (discovery.promotion-policy@1, amendable by versioning the plugin + re-compiling the Recipe), never code constants.

engine.doc: verify {mapping, probes, runId?, candidates?, candidatesRef?, mappingRef?} → promotion report {policy, results[], promoted[], stillDraft[], vaultRef} — probes simulate executing each mapped op against the fixture and check the postcondition (e.g. click send → a new message node appears in the outbox region). Semantic risk class: READ (verification evaluates evidence; risk fields are legal on contract-kind contributions only per the pinned manifest grammar).

policy.description: Promotion-gate policy as DATA: the thresholds that turn probe evidence into a PROMOTED SurfaceContract. Amendable by shipping a new plugin version + re-compiling the Recipe (the composition pins policy by content hash); never a code constant.

policy.doc: discovery.promotion-policy@1 — promotion thresholds: score ≥ 0.95 across ≥ 3 probes, every probe citing resolvable vault evidence. Confidence is never an input.

policy.description: The governed parser-pin registry as DATA (D-355 fail-closed genealogy, W1): the ONLY parser contributions a discovery.verify@1 run may carry in provider.parserPins. Each row must mirror a parser-kind contribution declared in a signed plugin manifest (provider-browser / provider-llm / vivim-chat); a pin outside this set is a REFUSAL at the gate, never a silent fallback — a parser that is not signed governance data cannot be the verified genealogy of a realization. Amendable only by shipping the new parser contribution + this registry row together (one reviewed change, content-hash pinned).

policy.doc: discovery.parser-registry@1 — the closed set of governed parser pins: parser:message.send:browser@1, parser:chat.complete:llm@1, parser:history.import:{chatgpt|claude|gemini}@1. An unpinned/unknown parser identity refuses discovery-derived re-verification (fail-closed genealogy).

capabilities.justification: Promotion events are appended to the USER'S VAULT (ns 'discovery', id 'promotion:<runId>', refs = every probe's evidence + candidatesRef + mappingRef — the full proof chain); port:vault.get@1 resolves each probe's evidence refs so 'evidence complete' means the refs EXIST in the vault (fail-closed: an unresolvable ref can never be part of a promotion). Granted per-composition by the user-signed Recipe, never by this manifest.
